detail: the rara avis dragon's feather quill, spoken of in the wider feather kind and never as a common flight feather: a great contour feather whose broad pennaceous vane carries structural iridescence over a soft plumulaceous base, filoplumes threading its base like whiskers, and the calamus hollow and cut to a bright nib

evidence.quote: structural iridescence over a soft plumulaceous base

facts.extent: 0.45 m from calamus tip to vane apex; the vane 0.10 m across at its widest
facts.scale_ref: as long as a grown man's forearm from elbow to fingertip; longer than any common quill
facts.material: pennaceous vane of structural iridescence over a plumulaceous base; hollow bright calamus
facts.state: shed whole in flight; unbroken; the vane still zipped by its hooklets
